description: Verify that DUT-emit UDP datagram carries the caller-specified Destination IP Address (RFC 768 'User Interface' MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The send primitive must carry the caller's dst_ip to the wire — the most fundamental routing decision. Wrong dst_ip means the datagram goes to the wrong host (or nowhere).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: send-UDP request via the user interface (dst_ip = Y)

2. Observation:
   • DUT → Tester: UDP datagram
     - dst_ip == Y   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted UDP carries dst_ip = Y.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_dst_ip — DUT emitted UDP with a different dst_ip
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any UDP within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted UDP carries the requested dst_ip — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_dst_ip: DUT emitted UDP with the wrong user-interface dst_ip
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT-originated UDP within the listen window
